transformations.namePolicy: Keep Unicode; NFC normalization, whitespace normalization and trim; 1–200 UTF-16 code units; no control characters or bidi overrides.
transformations.duplicatePolicy: One NFC/case-insensitive city name per country. Lowest source city ID supplies the canonical spelling; all usable state names and native spellings remain search keywords.
transformations.capitalPolicy: Only countries with no retained settlement rows receive their nonempty capital from the same pinned countries source, excluding the documented defunct-capital exception.
transformations.coordinatePolicy: Require finite coordinates within valid latitude/longitude ranges; coordinates are omitted from product assets.
transformations.ordering: Deterministic accent-folded lower-case name order with Unicode code-point tie-break; region and native keywords sorted likewise.

omittedCapitals.name: Plymouth
omittedCapitals.reason: The source capital is a defunct settlement in the volcanic exclusion zone; it is not offered as a city choice.
